nodes.label: ImageMedia
nodes.rationale: Uses relative URLs + getMediaUrl() to construct full URLs, then relies on remotePatterns in next.config.js for Next.js Image optimization. This avoids custom loaders for standard Payload media while allowing external CDNs via config.

nodes.label: Theme Initialization Script
nodes.rationale: Prevents Flash of Unstyled Content (FOUC) by applying the theme preference immediately before the page becomes interactive.

nodes.label: Search BeforeSync Hook
nodes.rationale: Ensures search documents have populated category titles and correct meta mapping for improved search relevance and visual consistency.

nodes.label: getMediaUrl
nodes.rationale: Local paths are kept relative so Next.js image optimization treats them as local rather than fetching through remotePatterns, which blocks private IPs since Next.js 16.

nodes.label: cn
nodes.rationale: Utility functions for UI components automatically added by ShadCN and used in a few of our frontend components and blocks.
